items.title: AI robots apparently can't do nothing: They start working even without instructions
items.excerpt: Six AI-powered robot models were tasked with performing activities in a simulation – but even without receiving any instructions, all of them started moving. Five systems even independently carried out tasks that nobody had asked them to perform. Researchers see this as a previously underestimated safety vulnerability in autonomous robots and demonstrate why even a simple stop command isn't a reliable solution.
